reaudit_note: Mechanical re-stamp by `./le rfc reseal`. Every verdict re-stamped below was in the SHIFTED state: its recorded unit fingerprints -- the enclosing top-level function of each tagged test -- were byte-identical to the tree, and only the file around them had moved (a line shift, a sibling test, an import rewrite). Nothing about what any of these tests asserts changed, so no verdict was re-judged and only the `tests` map was rewritten. A verdict whose unit, cited producer code, or requirement text moved was REFUSED and left stale for a human. The proof is the code in verdict_freshness(), not this note.

RFC5883-3-1.note: RA-BFD strict re-read 2026-09-27 (stale after DF-BFD-4). The row quotes RFC 5883 Section 3 verbatim: "Finally, the Echo function MUST NOT be used over multiple hops." (rfc5883.txt line 132). Forbidden: a multi-hop session that runs Echo. A session's DesiredMinEchoTxInterval, and the Required Min Echo RX it advertises (session.go Init), come only from a profile through profileConfig.applyTo, and every entry passes profileConfig.permitsMode. Red: TestRFC5883MultiHopEchoRejected Fatalf when pluginConfig.validate accepts an echo profile on a multi-hop pinned session; TestRFC5883ClientMultiHopEchoProfileRefused Fatal when EnsureSession returns a handle for a multi-hop client request naming an echo profile, or lacks the `enables echo` refusal. Positive, same profile on single hop: TestRFC5883SingleHopEchoAccepted (validate) and TestRFC5883ClientSingleHopEchoProfileAccepted (EnsureSession), so a blanket echo refusal fails. The engine holds no second guard (engine.go NewLoopWithEcho comment).

RFC5883-4.3-1.note: Re-read 2026-09-27. Forbidden: the sender taking the Passive role (silent). TestRFC5883DefaultSessionActiveArmsTx fails on m.role != RoleActive or a zero NextTxDeadline; TestRFC5883PassiveSessionDoesNotArmTx shows arming depends on the role.

RFC5883-4.3-2.note: Re-read 2026-09-27. Forbidden: a receiver in the Passive role transmitting before it has received a packet. TestRFC5883PassiveSessionSilentUntilRx fails on a non-zero NextTxDeadline before any Receive; TestRFC5883PassiveSessionTransmitsAfterRx shows the silence lifts on the first packet. Ze has no unidirectional-link notion: the operator configures passive, and the units prove the Passive role behaves as defined.

RFC5883-5-1.note: Judge 2026-09-30. §5 "...except that the UDP destination port MUST have a value of 4784." TestRFC5883MultiHopControlSentToPort4784OnTheWire observes the multihop datagram at :4784 (IPv4) and [::1]:4784 (IPv6); negative TestRFC5883SingleHopControlNeverAddressesPort4784 sees single-hop Control at :3784 and silence at :4784; Port+1 overlay reddens them. Weak because the tests bind fixed host ports (127.88.81.1/.2 :3784/:4784, [::1]:4784) in the root network namespace, so they fail when a running ze holds 0.0.0.0:3784 on the test host and collide with a parallel run of the package; the obligation is observable in a rootless user+net namespace (sadSelNetns pattern, internal/component/ike/engine/rfc4301_inbound_steps_linux_test.go), and the verdict stays weak until the units move there.

RFC5883-x-1.note: Re-read 2026-09-27; the quote is the same §3 sentence as RFC5883-3-1 and the same two units carry it. Forbidden: Echo used over multiple hops; TestRFC5883MultiHopEchoRejected fails when validate accepts it, TestRFC5883SingleHopEchoAccepted is the scoping contrast.
